title: Time cost of tracking
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans, let $x$ and $o$ be Boolean words, and let $T\in\mathbb{N}$. If $M$ halts on $x$ after exactly $T$ steps with output $o$ and uses some amount of work-tape space, then the tracked machine halts on $x$ after exactly $1+2T$ steps with the same output $o$ and uses some amount of work-tape space.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$M$ computes output $o$ from input $x$ within time bound $T$
replaced:
Let $M$ compute output $o$ on input $x$ within time $T$. Then the tracked evaluator of
$M$ computes the same output $o$ on $x$ within time $1 + 2T$.
